notes: Curated v0.1 EG6 offerings. Retail price is the physical catalog definition price. Used listings are one-off objects seeded once into the save, without rolled quality or condition-based physics.
work_notes: Provisional whole-day garage reservations, not factory labor estimates. Completion occurs at the start of the due day; several non-conflicting jobs may start on one day.
retail_fulfillment_notes: Two calendar days is a provisional game scheduling fixture for ordinary retail orders, not a claim about a named supplier or historical shipping time.
used_fulfillment_notes: The curated offers identify local sellers; zero-day pickup is a provisional game fixture and does not claim a specific meeting arrangement.

used_refresh.notes: At each new calendar week, available prior-week listings expire and a three-listing curated fixture is posted with new stable listing IDs. Reserved and sold listings remain in history.
